query:
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM email_links l WHERE l.id=$1 AND NOT l.is_sync_active
            AND l.disconnect_requested_at IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM email_mailbox_lifecycle_outbox o
                WHERE o.link_id=l.id AND o.payload->>'kind' IN ('cleanup_microsoft_watches','revoke_microsoft_grant'))) AS "ready!"
